description: HTML documentation page for the 'SubscriptionStatus' class in the Opencart Admin Model Localization namespace. It provides an overview, method signatures, and links to the source code.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Model\Localisation\SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Class representing subscription status management within Opencart's localization models. Inherits from Opencart\System\Engine\Model. Provides methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve subscription status information.

methods.name: addSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Adds a new subscription status entry to the system.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing subscription status identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Deletes a subscription status identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes subscription statuses for a specific language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific subscription status by its ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves multiple subscription statuses based on provided filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a subscription status in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for a given subscription status ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for all subscription statuses in a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription statuses.
